blocks.text: DAGUPAN CITY — A rough-toothed dolphin found stranded along the coast of San Fabian, Pangasinan, was safely released back into the sea on Sunday, Nov. 15, following a medical assessment by fisheries authorities. The dolphin, named “Novy” by personnel of the Bureau of Fisheries and Aquatic Resources (BFAR) Region I, was spotted by local fisherfolk on Saturday, Nov. 14. The fisherfolk immediately reported the stranded marine mammal and turned it over to the BFAR-National Fisheries Development Center in Dagupan City. BFAR Region I veterinarian Dr. Noel Difuntorum conducted a clinical assessment and found the dolphin stable and fit for immediate release, […]...
